title: SCAP-NG Variable Result draft v0.4.0 strawman
description: Resolved runtime Variable value set with explicit datatype, cardinality, status, and provenance.

datatype.description: OVAL-compatible Variable results are not record-typed; records are collected Item/entity structures.

status.description: Completeness/evaluation status of the resolved Variable value set. 'incomplete' explicitly preserves a partial known value stream; values and cardinality describe only observed values, not a proved total population. It does not establish evaluator propagation precedence.

item_refs.description: Local Items consumed while producing this Variable, including intermediate extraction/filter/selection use.
